y-m-14-05.title: Zvakarurama here 'kana iri line symmetric, ndeye point symmetric'? Kuyedza nemuenzaniso unopikisa
y-m-14-05.topic: Zvimiro ze line-symmetric ne point-symmetric: mienzaniso inopikisa
y-m-14-05.goal: Yedza, nekupeta nekutenderedza, kuti generalization nezvezvimiro ze line-symmetric ne point-symmetric (chirevo chechipiri) inogara ichishanda here, uye ipa uye utsanangure muenzaniso unopikisa iwe pachako.
y-m-14-05.material: Haram akati, “Kana chimiro chiri line symmetric, chiri point symmetric zvakare.” Chimiro che line-symmetric chimiro chinokodzera chaizvo pachacho kana chakapetwa nemutsetse, uye chimiro che point-symmetric chimiro chinokodzera chaizvo pachimiro chekutanga kana chatenderedzwa hafu yekutenderera (180°) kutenderedza poinzi. Hapana mifananidzo, saka funga zvimiro nemazita azvo. Funga rectangle sechiri isiri square, uye parallelogram seiri isiri rectangle kana rhombus.
y-m-14-05.thinking.1: Kuparadzanisa nzira mbiri dzekutarisa, kupeta nekutenderera hafu yekutenderera
y-m-14-05.thinking.2: Kugadzira muenzaniso unopikisa iwe pachako kuchirevo chisingashande
y-m-14-05.prereq.0: Chimiro che line-symmetric: chimiro chinokodzera chaizvo pachacho kana chakapetwa nemutsetse
y-m-14-05.prereq.1: Chimiro che point-symmetric: chimiro chinokodzera chaizvo pachimiro chekutanga kana chatenderedzwa hafu yekutenderera (180°) kutenderedza poinzi
y-m-14-05.s.s1.prompt: Pakati pezvimiro zvinotevera, sarudza zvimiro zvose zvinoratidza kuti chirevo chaHaram 'kana chimiro chiri line symmetric, chiri point symmetric zvakare' hachisi chechokwadi.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kune chimiro chimwe nechimwe, nyora mutafura ine makoramu maviri 'Pane mutsetse wawungapeta napo kuti zvikodzere here?' ne 'Chinokodzera kana chatenderedzwa hafu yekutenderera here?'
y-m-14-05.s.s1.hint.1: Taura kuti musanganiswa upi wemabhokisi mutafura waunoda kuputsa chirevo chaHaram.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.a: Sarudzo iyi yakatarisa zvose kuti chinokodzera kana chakapetwa uye kana chatenderedzwa hafu yekutenderera.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.b: Rectangle inokodzera zvose kana yapetwa nekana yatenderedzwa, saka haipikisani chirevo chaHaram. Kuratidza kuti chirevo hachina kururama, unoda chimiro chiri line symmetric asi chisiri point symmetric.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.c: Parallelogram haina mutsetse wawungapeta napo kuti ikodzere. Kuyedza chirevo chaHaram, chimiro chinofanira kutanga chava line symmetric.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.d: Sarudzo iyi yakatarisa zvose mutsetse unoita kuti chikodzere kana chapetwa uye kuti chinokodzera kana chatenderedzwa here.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.r.e: Rhombus inokodzera zvose kana yapetwa nekana yatenderedzwa, saka haipikisani chirevo chaHaram.
y-m-14-05.s.s1.explain: Muenzaniso unopikisa chimiro che 'line symmetric asi kwete point symmetric'. Equilateral triangle ne regular pentagon dzine mitsetse yadzinokodzera napo kana dzapetwa, asi hadzikodzeri chimiro chekutanga kana dzatenderedzwa hafu yekutenderera. Rectangle ne rhombus dzinokodzera nenzira dzose mbiri, uye parallelogram i point symmetric asi isiri line symmetric, saka haigoni kuva muenzaniso unopikisa chirevo ichi.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino Haram akati zvakapesana. “Kana chimiro chiri point symmetric, chiri line symmetric zvakare.” Parallelogram isiri rectangle kana rhombus inokodzera chimiro chekutanga kana yatenderedzwa hafu yekutenderera kutenderedza poinzi. Ungatonga sei chirevo chechipiri chaHaram uchishandisa parallelogram iyi?
y-m-14-05.s.s2.hint.0: Edza kucheka parallelogram papepa uye utarise kuti pane nzira yekuipeta zvekuti mativi ose maviri akodzere here.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.hint.1: Taura kuti chimiro chakadini chaizokwana kuratidza kuti chirevo che 'chechokwadi nguva dzose' hachina kururama.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.a: Kana ukatenderedza parallelogram hafu yekutenderera, inovhara chimiro chekutanga, saka i muenzaniso unoratidza kuti chirevo chekuti "kana i point symmetric, i line symmetric" chakarurama
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.a: Wakangotarisa kuti i point symmetric uye hauna kutarisa kana i line symmetric. Kuti chirevo chive chakarurama, inofanirawo kuva line symmetric.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.b: Chimiro chimwe hachigone kuratidza kuti chirevo chakaipa, saka tinofanira kutonga mushure mekutarisa zvimwe zvimiro zvakafanana zvishoma
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.b: Wakasiya shoko rekuti 'nguva dzose' rinogona kuputswa nemuenzaniso mumwe chete.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.c: Parallelogram haina mutsetse unoita kuti hafu dzivhare kana yapetwa, saka chimiro ichi chimwe chete chinoratidza kuti chirevo chakaipa
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.c: Kutonga uku kunobatanidza nzira yekutarisa nemhedziso.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.o.d: Kuti inovhara kana yapetwa uye kuti inovhara kana yatenderedzwa zvinotarisa chimwe chinhu chimwechete, saka kutarisa chimwe chete kwakakwana
y-m-14-05.s.s2.r.d: Kutarisa kuviri kunotarisa zvinhu zvakasiyana. Zvimwe zvimiro zvine chimwe chete chavo.
y-m-14-05.s.s2.explain: Kuti 'kana chimiro chiri point symmetric, chi line symmetric' chive chakarurama nguva dzose, chimiro chese chiri point symmetric chaifanira kuva nemutsetse unoita kuti chivhare kana chapetwa. Parallelogram isiri rectangle kana rhombus haina mutsetse unoita kuti ivhare kana yapetwa, saka i counterexample ye point symmetric asi isiri line symmetric. Counterexample imwe chete yakakwana kuputsa 'nguva dzose'.
y-m-14-05.s.s3.prompt: Ratidza chimiro chimwe, chisiri pakati pesarudzo dziri pamusoro, chiri line symmetric asi chisiri point symmetric. Nyora kuti chinoita sei kana chapetwa uye kuti chinoita sei kana chatenderedzwa hafu yekutenderera, uye utsanangure kuti sei chimiro ichocho i counterexample yechirevo chekutanga chaHaram.
y-m-14-05.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza chimiro, uye tanga wanyora kwaunogona kudhirowa mutsetse unoita kuti chivhare kana chapetwa.
y-m-14-05.s.s3.hint.1: Tevera kwaunoenda chikamu chaiva pamusoro kana ukatenderedza chimiro ichocho hafu yekutenderera.

y-m-14-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kwakaita mutsetse, kuratidza kuti chimiro chawakapa chinovhara chaizvo kana chapetwa here?
y-m-14-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora kuti sei hachivhari chimiro chekutanga kana chatenderedzwa hafu yekutenderera (chikamu chipi chinoenda kupi) here?
y-m-14-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakapa chimiro chakasiyana ne equilateral triangle ne regular pentagon here?
y-m-14-05.s.s3.model.0: Isosceles triangle (triangle ine mativi maviri akareba zvakaenzana) inovhara mativi ose kana ukaipeta kubva pavertex kuenda pakati pebase, saka i line symmetric. Asi kana yatenderedzwa hafu yekutenderera vertex inoenda pasi uye haivhari chimiro chekutanga, saka haisi point symmetric.
y-m-14-05.s.s3.model.1: Isosceles trapezoid ine divi repasi rakareba kupfuura repamusoro inovhara kana yapetwa napakati pekuruboshwe nekurudyi. Asi kana yatenderedzwa hafu yekutenderera divi refu rinoenda pamusoro uye haivhari chimiro chekutanga, saka haisi chimiro chiri point symmetric.

y-m-14-06.title: Unogona kugadzira marudzi mangani eframe ye rectangular prism ne 60 cm yewaya?
y-m-14-06.topic: Rectangular prism: huwandu hwehurefu hwema edges nekugadzira chimiro
y-m-14-06.goal: Taura mamiriro ehuwandu hwehurefu hwema edges se equation, wana pasina kusiya ma frame ese e rectangular-prism anoenderana nemamiriro akati wandei, uye utsanangure kuti pangava pasina frame kana mamiriro achichinja.
y-m-14-06.material: Unoda kushandisa 60 cm yewaya yose, pasina inosara, kugadzira frame (mapfupa asina mativi) akagadzirwa nema edges e rectangular prism chete. Waya inogona kucheneswa nekubatanidzwa, asi haufaniri kusiya chimedu chimwe chisina kushandiswa kana kuvhara chimwe. Kureba, upamhi, nekukwirira zvese i natural numbers (cm). Edge refu zvikuru yeframe inofanira kuva 9 cm kana kupfuura, uye edge pfupi zvikuru inofanira kuva 2 cm kana kupfuura.

y-m-14-06.thinking.1: Kuwana nenzira yakarongeka mhinduro dzakasiyana mukati memamiriro
y-m-14-06.thinking.2: Kutonga kuti pangava pasina mhinduro kana mamiriro achichinja

y-m-14-06.prereq.1: Kuziva kuti ma edges akatarisana e rectangular prism ane hurefu hwakaenzana
y-m-14-06.s.s1.prompt: Ndeapi anotaura zvakarurama, nekureba, upamhi, nekukwirira, mamiriro ekushandisa 60 cm yewaya yose pasina inosara?
y-m-14-06.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira bhokisi rine rectangle, verenga ma edges aro, uye ugadzire boka re edges ane hurefu hwakafanana.
y-m-14-06.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kuti ma edges mangani anoenderana nekureba.
y-m-14-06.s.s1.r.a: Pfungwa iyi yakaverenga ma edges matatu chete pa 12 sewaya. Verenga kuti frame ye rectangular-prism ine ma edges mangani.
y-m-14-06.s.s1.r.b: Pfungwa iyi yakaverenga ma edges ichiaita mabhoka ane hurefu hwakafanana.
y-m-14-06.s.s1.r.c: Pfungwa iyi yakaverenga ma edges ese 12 sehuwandu hwehurefu hutatu. Tarisa kuti pane ma edges mangani ehurefu hwakafanana hwega hwega.
y-m-14-06.s.s1.r.d: Pfungwa iyi yakaverenga kureba kwewaya sevolume. Waya inoshandiswa kumaedges ehurefu.
y-m-14-06.s.s1.explain: Rectangular prism ine ma edges 12, ane ma edges 4 anoenderana nekureba, upamhi, nekukwirira imwe neimwe. Saka kureba kwewaya i (kureba+upamhi+kukwirira)×4, uye kana iri 60, kureba+upamhi+kukwirira=15.

y-m-14-06.s.s2.hint.1: Pakupedzisira, tarisa kana edge pfupi zvikuru i 2 cm kana kupfuura uye kana edge refu zvikuru i 9 cm kana kupfuura.

y-m-14-06.s.s3.hint.0: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti huwandu hwehurefu hutatu i 15, uye uwane huwandu hwehurefu huviri hwakasara kana edge refu zvikuru i 12.

y-m-14-06.s.s3.r.a: Wakasiya imwe mamiriro. Ma edges ese anofanira kuva 2 cm kana kupfuura. Tarisawo huwandu zvakare.
y-m-14-06.s.s3.o.b: Inogona kugadzirwa. Semuenzaniso, gadzira frame ine kureba 12 cm, upamhi 3 cm, nekukwirira 3 cm.
y-m-14-06.s.s3.r.b: Hauna kutarisa kuti huwandu hwehurefu hutatu hunofanira kuva hwakadini.
y-m-14-06.s.s3.o.c: Haigone kugadzirwa. Kana ukashandisa 12 cm, huwandu hwehurefu huviri hwakasara i 3, saka ese haagone kuva 2 kana kupfuura.
y-m-14-06.s.s3.r.c: Sarudzo iyi yakaitwa nekushandisa mamiriro ehuwandu uye kuongorora hurefu huviri hwakasara.
y-m-14-06.s.s3.o.d: Hatigone kuziva. Hatigone kutaura chinhu kusvikira tangoedza kugadzira frame ine edge ye 12 cm.
y-m-14-06.s.s3.r.d: Kuedza i nzira imwewo, asi huwandu hwakasimbiswa pa 15, saka unogona kutonga nekufunga.
y-m-14-06.s.s3.explain: Huwandu hwehurefu hutatu i 15. Kana edge refu zvikuru i 12 kana kupfuura, huwandu hwehurefu huviri hwakasara i 3 kana kushoma, asi kuti ese ave 2 kana kupfuura huwandu hunofanira kuva 4 kana kupfuura. y-m-14-02.title: Tinofanira kuziva chii kuti tisarudze nzvimbo yepepa rekaiti rimwe?
y-m-14-02.topic: Nzvimbo yerombhasi: ruzivo runodikanwa kusarudza nzvimbo
y-m-14-02.goal: Rongedza kuti ndeupi ruzivo rwakakwana uye rwupi husina kukwana kusarudza nzvimbo yerombhasi, gadzira marombhasi akasiyana ane nzvimbo imwe chete, uye utsanangure kuti sei kureba kwedivi oga kusingasarudzi nzvimbo.
y-m-14-02.material: Basa rinogadzira makaiti epepa ane chimiro cherombhasi. Rombhasi ndiyo quadrilateral ine mativi mana ose akareba zvakafanana. Kaiti rega rega rinouya neruzivo rwakasiyana, uye tinoda kuziva kana ruzivo urwo oga runosarudza, sekukosha kumwe chete, nzvimbo yepepa rakashandiswa kugadzira kaiti rimwe. Kureba kwose kuri mu cm, uye kaiti rinofungwa sepepa rimwe rakatsetseka. Zvimedu zveruzivo zviri pazasi zvinoreva makaiti akasiyana.
y-m-14-02.thinking.1: Kufungidzira zvinosiyana nenzira dzakawanda nokuda kweruzivo rwunoshayikwa
y-m-14-02.thinking.2: Kugadzira mhinduro dzakasiyana dzine nzvimbo imwe chete
y-m-14-02.prereq.0: Kuziva kuti rombhasi quadrilateral ine mativi mana ose akareba zvakafanana
y-m-14-02.prereq.1: Kuziva madiagonali erombhasi nehwaro nokukwira kwepararerogiramu
y-m-14-02.s.s1.prompt: Kubva paruzivo rwuri pazasi, sarudza zvinhu zvose apo kuziva chimedu chimwe cheruzivo chete kunokuita kuti usarudze nzvimbo yepepa rekaiti sekukosha kumwe chete.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.hint.0: Pachimedu cheruzivo chega chega, tarisa kana unogona kufunga rombhasi inosangana nacho chaizvo asi ine nzvimbo yakasiyana.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tora furemu yerombhasi yakagadzirwa nokubatanidza tsvimbo 4 uye uidzvanye yakatsetseka kubva kudivi rimwe. Tarisa zvinochinja nezvinoramba zvakafanana.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.o.a: Mativi ose 4 ndi 30 cm, uye saka perimita ndi 120 cm
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.a: Kunyange kureba kwemativi kuchiva kwakafanana, nzvimbo inochinja kana rombhasi yadzvanywa yakatsetseka kana kumira. Kureba kwedivi hakusarudzi kuti inotsedzera zvakadini.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.o.b: Divi rimwe ndi 20 cm, uye kukwira kuenda kudivi iroro ndi 18 cm
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.b: Iyi ipfungwa yokuona rombhasi separarerogiramu ine hwaro nokukwira, saka nzvimbo yayo inogona kusarudzwa.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.c: Kunyangwe diagonal imwe yakafanana, nzvimbo inochinja kana diagonal imwe ichireba kana kupfupika.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.o.d: Hurefu hwema diagonal maviri ndi40 cm ne24 cm
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.d: Iyi ipfungwa yekuti hurefu hwema diagonal maviri hunotara hukuru nechimiro che rhombus.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.r.e: Hukuru hwekona hunotara chete chimiro chekutsvedzera, kwete hukuru (hurefu). Pane ma rhombus ehukuru hwakasiyana sezvaunoda.
y-m-14-02.s.s1.explain: Kutara nzvimbo, unofanira kuziva hukuru nechimiro pamwe chete. Ma diagonal maviri (40×24÷2=480 cm²) kana divi rimwe nekukwira kuenda kudivi iroro (20×18=360 cm²) zvinotara nzvimbo kuva kukosha kumwe chete. Nehurefu hwemativi mana oga, diagonal imwe oga, kana kona imwe oga, nzvimbo inogona kubuda nenzira dzakawanda.
y-m-14-02.s.s2.prompt: Uri kugadzira kite yakaita se rhombus ine nzvimbo ye240 cm². Sarudza hurefu a ne b hwema diagonal maviri (natural number, imwe neimwe 10 cm kana kupfuura uye 60 cm zvakanyanya) uye ugadzire ma kite 3 akasiyana. (Kuchinjanisa ma diagonal maviri kunoverengwa sekite imwe chete.)

y-m-14-07.title: Mhinduro yekuti kuti matai mangani anoiswa: inokanganisa kupi?
y-m-14-07.topic: Mayuniti earea: kushandura pakati pe m² ne cm², nekuisa matai
y-m-14-07.goal: Wana uye ugadzirise kukanganisa kwakaitwa pakushandura pakati pe m² ne cm², wana nenzira dzakawanda mamiriro apo matai anogona kuiswa pasina kucheneswa uye pasina mikaha, uye utonge kana zvichigoneka kana mamiriro achichinja.
y-m-14-07.material: Unoda kufukidza hwerevha yekirasi nematai e square ane 40 cm padivi rimwe nerimwe. Hwerevha yekirasi i rectangle ine kureba 6 m neupamhi 4 m. Matai haachenesi, uye anofukidza hwerevha yose pasina mikaha kana kuvhara. (1 m = 100 cm)
y-m-14-07.thinking.2: Kuenzanisa zvikonzero zviviri zvekuti chinhu hachigoneke
y-m-14-07.s.s1.prompt: Yunseo akawana huwandu hwematai anodiwa seizvi. Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga unokanganisa.
y-m-14-07.s.s1.hint.0: Padivi pemutsetse mumwe nemumwe, nyora kuti yuniti inoshandiswa i m, m², cm, kana cm².
y-m-14-07.s.s1.hint.1: Shandura square ine macheivi e 1 m kuita cm, uye uwane area yayo muna cm² zvakananga.
y-m-14-07.s.s1.line.2: 1 m i 100 cm, saka 24 m² i 2400 cm².
y-m-14-07.s.s1.line.3: Huwandu hwematai i 2400÷1600=1.5, saka matai 2 akakwana.
y-m-14-07.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 unokanganisa. Sezvo 1 m=100 cm, 1 m² i square ye 100 cm neye 100 cm, saka i 100×100=10000 cm². Ipapo 24 m² i 240000 cm², uye 240000÷1600=150 matai. Kana ukaienzanisa nechokwadi chekuti kunyange mutsetse mumwe unoda matai 15, 'matai 2' mumutsetse 4 hazvina musoro.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza cheivi yetai re square rinogona kufukidza hwerevha ye 6 m neye 4 m pasina mikaha uye pasina kucheneswa matai. Cheivi inofanira kuva natural number (cm) kubva ku 10 cm kusvika ku 100 cm. Wana hukuru hwakasiyana 3.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza kureba kwecheivi imwe yetai, uye utarise kana matai anokodzera chaizvo pa 600 cm yekureba.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.hint.1: Kunyange kana hukuru hukakodzera pakureba, tarisa zvakaparadzana kana pane chinosara kana chishoma pa 400 cm youpamhi.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.ok.c1: I natural number kubva ku 10 cm kusvika ku 100 cm.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Cheivi yetai inofanira kuva natural number (cm) kubva ku 10 cm kusvika ku 100 cm.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Pa 600 cm yekureba, matai anosara kana kushaikwa.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Pa 400 cm youpamhi, matai anosara kana kushaikwa.
y-m-14-07.s.s2.explain: Kubva ku 10 cm kusvika ku 100 cm, hukuru hunoshanda i hukuru 6 hwe 10, 20, 25, 40, 50, ne 100 cm. Semuenzaniso, ne 50 cm, matai 12 anokodzera pakureba uye 8 paupamhi, saka matai 96 anodiwa. Ne 30 cm kana 60 cm kureba kunoshanda, asi paupamhi hwe 400 cm haakodzeri chaizvo.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.prompt: Rumu rakachinja kuita 6 m kureba ne 4.5 m upamhi. Unoda kutonga kuti hwerevha haigone kufukidzwa pasina mikaha kana matai ane 40 cm akafanana akashandiswa pasina kucheneswa. Sarudza zvikonzero zvese zvakakodzera zvekutonga uku.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nhamba dzipi dzinofanira kuva natural numbers munzira inoshandisa area nemunzira inoshandisa kureba.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.hint.1: Shandura 6 m kuita 600 cm ne 4.5 m kuita 450 cm, uye uone kuti matai mangani anokodzera padivi rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.o.a: Kana ukapatsanura area 27 m²=270000 cm² ne 1600 cm² yetai, unowana matai 168.75, isiri natural number
y-m-14-07.s.s3.r.a: Pfungwa iyi yakatongwa nemamiriro ekuti huwandu hwematai hunofanira kuva natural number.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.o.b: 4.5 m haisi natural number, saka kunyange mushure mekushandura kuita cm hatigone kuverenga kuti matai mangani anokodzera mumutsetse umwe
y-m-14-07.s.s3.r.b: Kutonga uku kwakati matai haagone kuiswa nekuti decimal yakaonekwa. 450 cm i kureba kwe natural-number.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.o.c: Kana ukaisa matai mumutsetse umwe paupamhi hwe 450 cm, matai 11 anokodzera uye 10 cm inosara, saka haigone kufukidzwa pasina kucheneswa
y-m-14-07.s.s3.r.c: Pfungwa iyi yakatarisa mamiriro uchishandisa kureba kwedivi rimwe.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.o.d: Rumu rakava rakakura, saka kana matai akawanda akashandiswa, dambudziko rehukuru husingakodzeri rinoenda, uye rinogona kufukidzwa pasina kucheneswa
y-m-14-07.s.s3.r.d: Pfungwa iyi yakatora kuti kushandisa matai akawanda kunoita kuti dambudziko rehukuru husingakodzeri ridzime. Dambudziko hariri huwandu hwematai asi kana hurefu hunokodzera chaizvo.
y-m-14-07.s.s3.explain: Nearea, 270000÷1600=168.75, uye nekureba, 450÷40=11.25, saka zvose zvinotsigira kutonga kuti haigone kufukidzwa pasina mikaha kunze kwekunge matai acheneswa. Chokwadi chekuti 4.5 m i decimal kana kuti huwandu hwematai hwawedzerwa hachisi chikonzero.

y-m-14-08.title: Kana ukafungidzira area yeshizha negrid, unogona kuenda kusvika kupi mukutaura?

y-m-14-08.material: Wakaisa shizha pagrid paper apo square rimwe nerimwe i 1 cm upamhi uye 1 cm kukwirira, uye wakadhirowa kutenderedza muganhu waro. Area ye grid square rimwe i 1 cm². Hyunwoo anoda kufungidzira area yedhirowa reshizha iri. Muganhu wakakombama, saka haukodzeri ma squares chaizvo.
